story.title: What happens if an entire class of workers loses faith in their careers

draft:
I've been noticing a trend of disillusionment among tech workers. 
As I read about the struggles of my peers, I'm struck by the sense of burnout and discontent. 
Key issues include lack of fulfillment and poor work-life balance. 
What's driving this crisis of faith in tech careers? 
#techcareers #burnout #careerfulfillment
